title: Michael Stands Up and the Dead Are Awakened
description: Michael, the great prince who protects God's people, will stand up. Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to eternal life, others to shame and everlasting contempt. The wise will shine like the brightness of the sky, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever [ref:Dan 12:1-3|Daniel 12:1-3].
